signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in to your Westray and Papa Westray account.
signIn.secondFactorIntro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.verified: Thank you: your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
signIn.verificationFailed: That confirmation link has expired or was already used. Sign in, and if your address still needs confirming we will send a new link.
signIn.passwordReset: Your password is changed. Sign in with your new one.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.intro: An account lets you join in as a member of the community: your profile, and more as the site grows.
signUp.sent: Thank you. Check your email for a link to confirm your address; it may take a few minutes to arrive. If you already have an account, sign in instead.

forgotPassword.title: Forgotten your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account uses that address, we have sent it a link to choose a new password. It works for 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: Choosing a new password signs you out everywhere.
resetPassword.missingToken: This page works from the link in your email. Ask for a new link if yours has expired.

secondFactor.title: Protect your account
secondFactor.intro: Every member signs in with a second step as well as a password, so nobody else can use your account even if they learn your password. Choose one to finish signing in.
secondFactor.appIntro: An app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 2FAS, shows a new six-digit code every 30 seconds.
secondFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key into it. Then enter the code it shows.
secondFactor.backupCodesIntro: Each code works once, if you ever lose your phone. Write them down or print them and keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
secondFactor.passkeyIntro: A passkey uses your phone's or computer's own lock (fingerprint, face or PIN) instead of a code, and cannot be tricked into signing in to a fake site.
secondFactor.addPasskey: Add a passkey on this device
secondFactor.stepUpIntro: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.

reauthenticate.title: Confirm it is you
reauthenticate.intro: For your safety, enter your password again before making this change.

overview.title: Account
overview.intro: Your account on Westray and Papa Westray. Your profile says what others may see of you; security covers how you sign in.
overview.noGroups: You are not in any groups yet. Clubs, committees and businesses arrive soon.
overview.pauseIntro: Pausing hides you from the community and stops anything being sent to you, until you resume. You can still sign in to resume.
overview.pausedIntro: Your account is paused: nobody sees you and nothing is sent to you.
overview.closeIntro: Closing your account deletes your profile and your sign-in details at the end of a grace period. Until then you can change your mind.
overview.closing: Your account is closing, and will be deleted at the end of its grace period. Until then you can keep it.
